text: [40] ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme . athakho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya kosambiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi . athakho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi atippago kho tāva kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ yannūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyanti . athakho āyasmā ānando yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo #1 ma. cepi . tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodi sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi . tena kho pana samayena tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi yo hi koci āvuso dvādasa vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati niddaso bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāyāti . athakho āyasmā ānando tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandi nappaṭikkosi anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmīti athakho āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantoL yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ
